description.value: Pad Thai Restaurant is a family-owned Thai eatery in Pitt Meadows operated by sisters Jenny and Jessie Trakulthongroj since December 1999, built on treasured family recipes adapted for a modern palate. The restaurant has earned multiple Times Readers Choice awards for Best Thai Restaurant in the Pitt Meadows/Maple Ridge area and has developed a loyal following across the Tri-cities region. Touring cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley corridor will find a warm, established dining room serving signature dishes like house Pad Thai and Tom Yum Koong, with online ordering also available.
